system.summary: Fire aura: damage each round according to distance, from 1d10 (OR 7-10) within 1 m to 1d10 at 5-10 m.
system.description:
The demon is on fire. Depending on how close someone stands to the demon, they obtain different amounts of damage points each action round according to the chart.

DistanceDamage per round
Less than 1 m1d10 (OR 7-10)
1-2 m1d10 (OR 8-10)
2-3 m1d10 (OR 9-10)
3-5 m1d10 (OR 10)
5-10 m1d10
